text:
Alana (PM): Quick check-in re: Console observability scope. We have three recurring asks from enterprise pilots: route dashboards, trace-linking, and per-model cost visibility. I'm proposing a tight Phase A to hit a pilot in 6w. Need quick feedback and blockers.

Alana (PM): Phase A (MVP) proposal:
- Route dashboards: P50/P90 latency, RPS, error rate, simple cost estimate per route
- Cost breakdown: token-based estimate per model + route tag, confidence band
- Tracing hook: inject/propagate X-Span-ID and link to customer's trace backend (no span storage)
- Error analytics: counters, baseline comparisons on prompt sets, regression alerting

Raj (Eng): +1 to scope. For tracing we can do header passthrough + a generated span ID when absent. Link out to existing APM with URL template (customer-configured). Keeps storage minimal.

Mei (SRE): Storage and ingestion are biggest risks. Recommend default sample rate 1% and retention of span metadata 7d, aggregated histograms 30d. Also want an emergency throttle (safe-mode) to drop to 0.1% if we hit an ingestion spike.

Carlos (Data): Cost calc approach: tokens_in/out * model_unit_cost + fixed routing overhead. We'll add route_id and model_id to telemetry events. Also surface a "drift" metric: sampled % diff vs actual billing so CS can triage.

Priya (CS): Two pilots (FinCorp, MedApp) need trace links for audits and per-model cost estimates. Sampling okay as long as trace link is available for flagged errors. They'll accept a caveat that console cost is an estimate, not billing.

Tom (Design): UX: ship three starter dashboards (latency, cost, errors) + route page toggle to enable tracing. Drilldown: click span -> opens trace backend in new tab. Keep builder advanced features for v2.

Alana (PM): Minimal instrumentation spec (engineering):
1) generate X-Span-ID at entry if absent; propagate to runtimes
2) emit event per request: route_id, model_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, span_id, error_flag
3) default sampling: 1%; per-customer override via config
4) retention: span metadata 7d, histograms 30d

Raj (Eng): Implementation notes: reuse existing events pipeline, small schema migration to add span_id and model_id. Can we freeze telemetry schema until post-launch?

Alana (PM): Freeze schema for this launch. Extra optional fields ok but avoid required fields.

Mei (SRE): Add alert when trace ingestion > 200 rps and a dashboard for ingestion so we can flip safe-mode quickly. ops-bot can you sketch alert?

ops-bot: Created alert telemetry.trace_ingestion_high threshold=200 rps, responder=#eng-oncall.

Carlos (Data): Also add a periodic job that computes cost-drift sample and writes a report to the console for CS to inspect.

Priya (CS): If we can promise trace-link + cost-estimate for pilots, they'll commit to pilot by next week. Time sensitive.

Alana (PM): Proposed timeline:
- Wks 0-2: schema + header passthrough + sampling plumbing
- Wks 3-4: aggregation, cost prototype, histograms
- Wk 5: dashboard templates, enable toggle, alerts
- Wk 6: pilot rollout + validation

Raj (Eng): 6 weeks is tight but plausible if we keep traces lightweight and reuse infra. I'll call out blockers in RFC.

Mei (SRE): :warning: need clear ingestion quotas for noisy customers and a runbook for safe-mode.
Carlos (Data): +1
Priya (CS): +1, will coordinate pilots
Tom (Design): +1, mocks incoming Monday
ops-bot: :thumbsup:
